description.value: Tasty Tandoori Grill is a family-run Indian restaurant in Vanderhoof serving authentic tandoor dishes, biryanis, and a broad menu spanning vegetarian, meat, and seafood options. The restaurant is wheelchair accessible and offers dine-in, takeout, and delivery, as well as a private dining room that can host events for up to 50 people. Meats are noted as locally sourced, and most menu items are described as gluten-free.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content at restaurantvanderhoof.com confirms this is an active Indian restaurant at 2456 Burrard Avenue, Vanderhoof, BC, with phone 250.567.7086. OSM tags (toilets=yes, toilets:access=customers, toilets:wheelchair=yes, wheelchair=yes) provide washroom and accessibility evidence; the website confirms takeout and a vegetarian/vegan menu section plus a gluten-free note. One concern: the /about.php page contains un-customized template boilerplate referencing 'Seminyak' (Bali, Indonesia), suggesting the website was built from a generic template not fully edited, but the contact details and menu appear locally specific and credible.
concerns: OSM record has no address or phone fields; both sourced from website only.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active Indian restaurant in Vanderhoof with a functioning website, confirmed address, and phone number. Useful stop for touring cyclists passing through the Cariboo/Central Interior region.
